watches.name: Feynman Coalesce - The "Panda"
watches.description: The “Panda” is a tribute to the first ever Panda cub born in Singapore named Le Le. He was born on 14th Aug 2021 after seven attempts by his parents to conceive over a period of 9 years in Singapore. The Panda, as a symbol, is deeply entrenched in the Eastern culture, representing peace, luck, and wisdom, they are well-loved and are currently classified as endangered animals. The artwork on the watch dial shows the Panda in its natural habitat the bamboo forest enjoying the bamboo shoots around it. The Cloisonné enameling technique is used here, with gradient work carefully applied to produce the various color tones. The straps feature a traditional bamboo-inspired design, it is fully hand stitched and crafted in Singapore. The dials, straps, and watch assembly are all done locally in Singapore and represent the brand’s second attempt at a Métiers d ’ Art watch. Feynman Timekeepers is a small independent watch-maker based in Singapore, with just 5 years in existence. We create compelling timepieces, each challenging conventional aesthetics. The Coalesce "Panda" will be priced at 8888 Singapore Dollars and it will be limited to only 9 pieces worldwide. Production will begin in August 2022 and the majority of the orders should be fulfilled by the early of 2023.

It is no surprise that the Tiger Eye is one of our first choices when designing the Q. Tiger's Eye exhibits a silky, golden sheen that seems to move as the light catches it, adding visual interest to the watch. The stone's warm, golden tones evoke a sense of luxury and sophistication. *Color of the strap may defer due to the batch of leather received* Specifications: 34mm gold colored case 38mm lug to lug 7mm thin Tiger's Eye Gemstone dial Swiss Quartz Calibre Ronda 1014 Handcrafted strap by @yi.leatherco

watches.name: Feynman Fjorde "Magma"
watches.description: The Feynman Fjorde collection sees the brand revisiting the popular Cove’s dive-watch, twin-crown silhouette, with the integration of a navigation compass. The model seeks to fulfil an absence of land-based navigation watches in the small-independent watch-making scene, and will be driven by the venerable ETA2895-2 automatic caliber. Made in a small-batch production, the watch features an all-new luminous pigment developed in Singapore, under Chrono.AMR. The compass bezel displays cardinal, inter-cardinal and secondary inter-cardinal directions, with 3 models featuring English points, while a limited edition model features Arabic directions.
